newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks tumble in thin trade ahead of US data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks tumble in thin trade ahead of US data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks tumbled on Friday as market participants backed off to the sidelines ahead of the weekend and to wait for U.S. payrolls data due out later in the day.
Brokers said the U.S. indicator was weighing heavily on a market already mired in anxiety over Japan's elections.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 slid 183.47 points or 0.86 percent to settle at 21,148.03. Its December futures were down 140 points 21,170.
"Wall Street put on the brakes overnight after hitting record highs to wait for the data, and Japan is basically doing the same," said Toyo Securities strategist Haruo Nakaharu.
